local_integration.agent_transport: standard upstream OpenAI Realtime adapter with explicit local WebSocket base_url
local_integration.transport_liveness: 20 second keepalive pings remain enabled; the Pong timeout is explicitly disabled for publishable local runs because the official discrete simulator can pause application receives while its user LLM generates
local_integration.retry_policy: at most three exception-only whole-task infrastructure retries with a fixed one-second delay and the same task seed; semantic outcomes are never retried and all attempt artifacts are preserved
local_integration.caller_synthesis_output: mono PCM16 resampled to the configured benchmark PCM rate
local_integration.credential_policy: OPENAI_REALTIME_API_KEY is the dedicated local-only gateway token; hosted OPENAI_API_KEY is never sent to the local endpoint; FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY is optional and never serialized

verification.live_provider_suite_execution_condition: final full pass used CPU affinity and FIFO priority 10 for the unchanged benchmark client on a 0%-idle shared host; two ordinary-scheduler reruns each had one wall-clock tick above 300 ms

blockers_observed: The complete 278-task control and regular cells, repeated trials, cadence sweeps, and native comparison conditions have not yet completed.
GPT-Live and TML Interaction Model endpoints are not publicly executable in the current environment, so their published claims remain contextual rather than local scores.
reporting_rule: Do not report an OpenRealtime tau-Voice score until the pinned provider adapter passes upstream tests and the complete declared task/condition cell finishes. Partial text-only, mock-tool, or interaction-only runs are not tau-Voice scores.
